text: When workers cut down the tree in his backyard, twelve-year-old Glen and his older friend Terry find a large geode and [a hole in the ground|trigger|unsealing what was shut away]. With Glen's parents away and his sister Al in charge, the boys [read its incantations aloud|origin|deliberately called up], and a heavy metal album convinces Terry the hole is a gateway to [a domain of evil gods|threat|the devil and dark gods]. Then [the family dog Angus|who_suffers|animals] dies, [a swarm of moths|images|vermin and creeping things] shatters the bedroom window, and demonic arms reach out from under a bed.
